option_b: Houseboats on Dal Lake are one of the attractions of Srinagar.
option_c: Many families in Srinagar live in Dongas which are built in hilly areas.
option_d: The old houses here are made of stone, bricks and wood.

65. More than a thousand years ago, Al-Biruni, a traveller from Uzbekistan, had described his observations about India. Which of the following observations were recorded in Al-Biruni's book?
A. People of India are very skilled at making ponds.
B. Horses are used to draw carts in India.
C. Step-wells have separate steps for going up and coming down.
D. Lakes and Johads are built to collect water.
Choose the correct option.

67. Read Assertion (A) and Reason (R) carefully:
Assertion (A): Domestication of animals was a gradual process that took place in many parts of the world.
Reason (R): The earliest domesticated animals include sheep and goat.
Choose the correct option.
option_a: Both A and R are true but R does not explain A.
option_b: A is true but R is false.
option_c: A is false but R is true.
option_d: Both A and R are true and R explains A.

option_d: Facts, principles and laws of EVS

question_text: 77. Harleen asked her teacher, "Why do roses have thorns?" What must be the pedagogy of an EVS teacher towards this curiosity?
option_a: Tell that all roses do not have thorns.
option_b: Tell her to find out which other plants have thorns.
option_c: Ask her to observe animals eating plants with and without thorns.
option_d: Tell that roses have thorns to protect itself from animals.

question_text: 78. Isha of class IV asked her teacher, "Why cow does not lay eggs?" What is your most appropriate response if you are Isha's teacher?
option_a: Ask her to relate laying of eggs/giving birth to their visible ears and whose ears cannot be seen.
option_b: Ask her to find out herself the reason for this.
option_c: Ask other students of the class to answer Isha's question.
option_d: Reply that cows are mammals which give birth to young ones.

79. An EVS teacher wants to use storytelling as a strategy for teaching and learning. Which of the following are the most suitable for this?
A. Contextual stories
B. Folk stories
C. Student-written stories
D. Stories focussing on morals
Choose the correct option.

80. Teacher asked students to draw an animal. Poonam draws an animal, having body parts of different animals. What should the teacher do?
A. Scold Poonam for drawing an absurd animal.
B. Ask Poonam why she has drawn parts of different animals.
C. Tell Poonam that no such animal exists.
D. Ask Poonam the name of the animal she has drawn.
Choose the correct option.

81. If a teacher wants that students learn about the plant diversity, which of the following are the most suitable activities for this?
A. Ask students to look for objects which have patterns of leaves on them in their house.
B. Recite a poem to students written on different types of plants and their characteristics.
C. Blindfold students and ask the students to identify plants by smelling crushed leaves.
D. Ask students to collect the leaves of plants and make pictures of different animals using the leaves.
Choose the correct option.

82. Which of the following elements best describe the nature of EVS?
A. Established facts
B. Logical information
C. Observation
D. Scientific terminology
E. Experimentation
Choose the correct option.

83. Read the following statements A and B carefully:
A. Recommendation of NCF (2005) is to discourage rote learning of information.
B. Recommendation of NCF (2005) is to discourage maintenance of sharp boundaries between different subject areas.
Choose the correct option.
option_a: Both A and B are false.
option_b: A is true but B is false.
option_c: A is false but B is true.
option_d: Both A and B are true.

A. In EVS learning, the challenge is to respect the multicultural dimensions of diverse classrooms.

Choose the correct option.
option_a: Both A and B are false.
option_b: A is true but B is false.
